derivation:
by
  change A.fv.sup id + 2 ∉ A.fv
  exact fun h => (show ¬ A.fv.sup id + 2 ≤ A.fv.sup id by omega) (Finset.le_sup (f := id) h)
explanation: Unfolding the dummy variable and freshVar gives the finite supremum plus two. Finset.le_sup bounds every member by that supremum, yielding an arithmetic contradiction. The current proof invokes a library-local freshness theorem instead.
